name: btc-060-martingale-bot
description: BTC 5m/15m Up/Down martingale bot for Polymarket — wait 2m/6m after open, fire the $50 entry on the leading side at any price, ONE $100 flip instantly when the opposite side hits 0.50 (no flips after 280s/870s, losing side sold ~2s later), separate demo capital per timeframe, side above 0.90 wins, with live equity/drawdown/win-rate dashboard.
